accepted.sentence: At home, keeping this fruit beside apples can hasten softening, since both release ethylene as they ripen.
Below roughly 13°C, chilling during storage can discolor the peel and impair normal ripening after the fruit returns to warmth.
In many tropical kitchens, the plant’s broad leaves are used to wrap foods for cooking or serving.
In parts of South and Southeast Asia, the unopened flower cluster is cooked as a vegetable, often after soaking to reduce bitterness.
People with latex allergy sometimes react to this fruit as well, because certain proteins in the two sources are structurally similar.
Mashed ripe pulp is sometimes offered as an early complementary food for infants because its soft consistency is easy to swallow.
Dwarf cultivars are occasionally grown in large pots as ornamentals in warm conservatories or protected indoor spaces.
Where imported grain is costly, this crop can provide an affordable, carbohydrate-rich staple in tropical household diets.
